caption: The Agent page of the app with our question 3 post ideas to boost engagement this week and the answer with three generic ideas (a this or that choice on Wednesday, a behind the scenes moment on Friday and one useful tip on Sunday), the yellow button Connect an account, the banner 7 days left in your free trial with See plans, and in the left menu the empty section Accounts with Connect your first account; the name of the workspace at the top left of the menu is hidden.

The Create Post window with the tabs Post and Story and the buttons Hashtags and AI Assist, with a caption written by AI Assist for a spring sale of a small coffee shop (195 characters, with four hashtags), and on the left the panel Select Accounts with the six network icons, the text No account to publish to (Connect Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X or Threads, then come back to this post), a Connect account button, and at the bottom No account connected yet, save it as a draft, with Cancel and Save Draft; the name of the workspace at the top left of the menu is hidden.

The window Choose your plan on the Yearly tab (2 months free) in dollars: Starter $15.83 /mo (you save $38), Team $32.5 /mo (most popular, you save $78, selected, with the bottom line $390 /yr billed yearly and an Upgrade button), Pro $49.17 /mo (you save $118) and Max $82.5 /mo (you save $198), with the lists of what each plan includes; the Upgrade button was not used; the name of the workspace at the top left of the menu is hidden.

The Settings window on the tab Profile with the section Delete Account (Once you delete your account, there is no going back, and the list of what is deleted: the profile and personal data, all spaces and workspaces, all connected social accounts, all posts and drafts) and a red Delete Account link that was not used, and the other tabs Connected Accounts, Subscription and API Keys; the name of the workspace at the top left, the name at the top of the window and the profile name and e-mail fields are hidden.
